blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).
blocks.zh: 通过增加参数计数和计算,传播变压器(DiTs)比例模型容量. Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)变体扩展参数容量,同时保持每个托肯计算大致固定,但仍需要大量参数存储. 在本文中,我们提出动态循环 MoE DIT(DyLoMo-DIT),它可以重新使用参数而不是添加参数:一个权重共享的循环反复应用中间层,而稀疏的专家则将参数容量分配到符号之间. 这种设计在不添加参数的情况下加深了网络,将参数预算腾出来用于其他用途,如更多的专家或更独特的层. 它还以动态方式分配计算,不同噪音水平的通过次数。 实验表明,DyLoMo-DIT更有效地利用参数和计算预算,从给低噪音步骤分配更多的通行证中获得更多收益。 在ImageNet256\times256$上,DyLoMo-DIT在匹配参数和计算预算时将FID比DiT减少11-24%,比DiT-MoE减少36-56%. 对于文本到图像生成,一个缩放的DyLoMo-DIT实现了比FLUX.1(0.714 vs. 0.673)更高的GenEval分数,其活性参数不到十分之一(1.05B vs. 12B).

blocks.en: As diffusion models grow in size, scaling them to improve generation quality also increases computational and memory costs [ 21 , 6 , 68 ] . More efficient scaling therefore requires making better use of model parameters and computation, rather than simply increasing both.
blocks.zh: 随着传播模型规模的扩大,扩大模型以提高生成质量也增加了计算和内存成本[21,6,68]. 因此,更高效的衡量需要更好地利用模型参数和计算,而不是简单地增加两者。

blocks.en: DiT [ 52 ] applies the same dense layer stack at every denoising step. Increasing its width raises both the parameter count and per-token computation, while adding independently parameterized layers increases both depth and parameter count. Although timestep conditioning changes the network’s activations, it does not change the layers or computation used at each step. MoE-DiTs such as DiT-MoE [ 23 ] use sparse experts [ 61 ] to expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. Both designs maintain uniform depth across noise levels, even though high-noise steps primarily establish global structure and low-noise steps refine detail [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: DiT [52] 在每个调试步骤上应用相同的密层堆栈. 增加它的宽度既提高参数计数,又提高每盘计算,同时增加独立的参数化层则提高深度和参数计数. 虽然时间步调条件会改变网络的激活,但它不会改变每个步骤所用的层或计算. 如DiT-MoE[23]等MOE-DiTs使用稀疏的专家[61]扩展参数容量,同时保持按键计算大致固定,但仍需要大量参数存储. 这两种设计在噪声水平上保持统一的深度,尽管高噪声步骤主要建立全球结构,低噪声步骤细化细节[5].

blocks.en: Depth offers another way to use model parameters more efficiently. Recurrently applying a group of weight-shared layers increases effective depth while storing only one set of parameters for the repeated layers. This reduces the parameter cost of added depth and frees budget for experts. Recurrent depth has been explored in language models and, more recently, in diffusion Transformers [ 28 , 12 , 19 , 73 ] . However, recurrence alone does not determine where the additional computation is most useful: a fixed pass count applies the same extra computation at every noise level, while dense feed-forward networks lack MoE’s token-dependent parameter capacity. In our matched-budget ablation, a uniform two-pass loop does not improve FID at the DiT-MoE-B budget ( Sec. 5.4 ). These observations motivate combining parameter-efficient recurrent depth with sparse experts and adapting computation across the denoising trajectory.
blocks.zh: 深度提供了另一种更有效地使用模型参数的方法. 经常应用一组重合层会提高有效深度,同时只存储一组重复层的参数. 这减少了增加深度的参数成本,并为专家腾出预算。 在语言模型以及最近在传播变形器[28、12、19、73]中探索了经常性的深度。 然而,单是重复并不能确定额外计算在什么地方最有用:固定的通过计数在每个噪声级别上都应用同样的额外计算,而密集的向导网络则缺乏MOE的信号依赖参数能力. 在我们的对应预算削减中,一个统一的双通环并不能改善DiT-MoE-B预算的FID(第5.4节)。 这些观察促使将参数效率高的经常性深度与稀少的专家结合起来,并调整整个去名轨迹的计算。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), an architecture that jointly allocates parameter capacity, computation, and depth under a target parameter and compute budget. Its feed-forward networks use multi-head sparse experts to route each token to a small subset of experts, expanding parameter capacity across tokens while keeping per-token computation nearly fixed. A group of middle Transformer layers shares weights across recurrent passes, adding effective depth without storing a separate copy of the layer parameters. The resulting parameter savings can be reinvested in more experts. DyLoMo-DiT also uses a dynamic loop schedule that varies the number of passes with the noise level. Assigning more passes to low-noise inputs, rather than applying the same number of passes throughout denoising, brings further gains. This design differs from DiT, which uses a fixed dense layer stack, and MoE-DiT, which expands token-dependent parameter capacity but retains uniform depth across noise levels. The expert configuration, looped segment, routing heads, and pass schedule are jointly selected for the target budget.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出动态循环MOE DIT(DyLoMo-DIT),这个架构在一个目标参数和计算预算下共同分配参数容量,计算,和深度. 其向导网络使用多头稀疏的专家将每个信物传递给一小批专家,扩大参数跨信物的容量,同时使每枚信物计算几乎固定不变。 一组中间变形器层在反复通道之间共享权重,增加有效深度而不存储层参数的单独副本. 由此产生的参数节省可以再投资于更多的专家。 DyLoMo-DIT也使用动态环路表,该表随噪音级别而改变通过次数. 将更多的通行证分配给低噪音的投入,而不是在整个发号施令期间使用同样数量的通行证,将带来更多的收益。 这种设计与DiT不同,DiT使用固定的密层堆栈,而MoE-DiT则扩展了信使依赖的参数容量,但保留了跨噪声层的统一深度. 专家配置,循环段,路由头,及通过时间表均共同选定目标预算.

blocks.en: We evaluate DyLoMo-DiT on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 and in text-to-image generation. At matched parameter and forward-compute budgets, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11%, 14%, and 24% relative to DiT in the B, L, and XL tiers, respectively, and by 36%, 56%, and 56% relative to DiT-MoE in the S, B, and L tiers under the same training protocol. The advantage persists against scaled-up baselines: a DiT with three times the parameters and compute still has 13% higher FID, while the original DiT-MoE-XL configuration, with six times the parameters, has 63% higher FID. Further analyses show how the joint design contributes to these gains: at the DiT-MoE-B budget, progressively adding the design choices lowers FID from 16.06 to 5.28 ( Sec. 5.4 ). Extra passes improve results primarily at low noise, while routers without explicit timestep inputs learn to specialize by noise level. Finally, a scaled text-to-image variant scores higher than FLUX.1 on GenEval at 1024 2 1024^{2} (0.714, compared with 0.673 for FLUX.1-schnell and 0.671 for FLUX.1-dev) with less than one tenth as many active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).
blocks.zh: 我们在ImageNet上评价DyLoMo-DIT 256×256 256\times 256和文本到图像生成. 在匹配参数和前置计算预算中,DyLoMo-DIT在B级、L级和XL级分别比DiT减少11%、14%和24%,在同一培训协议下比DiT-MoE减少36%、56%和56%。 相对于扩大的基线,这一优势依然存在:一个具有三倍参数和计算量的DiT仍然拥有13%的FID,而原始的DiT-MoE-XL配置,拥有六倍参数,拥有63%的FID. 进一步的分析表明联合设计如何促进这些收益:在DiT-MOE-B预算中,逐步增加设计选择,使FID从16.06降至5.28(第5.4节)。 额外通道主要在低噪音下改善结果,而没有明确时间步输入的路由器则通过噪音水平学习专门化. 最后,一个缩放的文本对图像变体在GenEval上得分高于FLUX.1,在1024 2 1024^{2}(0.714,而FLUX.1-schnell的得分为0.673,FLUX.1-dev的得分为0.671),活性参数不到十分之一(1.05B vs 12B).

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • Parameter-efficient recurrent depth for diffusion Transformers. DyLoMo-DiT reuses a group of middle layers to increase effective depth without duplicating their parameters, freeing budget for sparse experts. • Dynamic loop allocation across noise levels. DyLoMo-DiT assigns different numbers of passes along the denoising trajectory, with more passes at low noise. • Joint allocation of parameters, computation, and depth under a shared budget. Sparse experts allocate capacity across tokens, weight sharing controls the parameter cost of added depth, and the loop schedule distributes computation across noise levels. • A scalable design space for dense and sparse-expert diffusion Transformers. DyLoMo-DiT scales across model sizes and includes DiT, MoE-DiT, and looped DiT as special cases.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: DyLoMo-DIT重用一组中层来增加有效深度而不重复其参数,为稀少的专家腾出预算. · 不同噪音水平的动态循环分配。 DyLoMo-DIT沿去诺音轨分配不同数量的传球,低噪声时会有更多的传球. • 支助 在共同预算下联合分配参数、计算和深度。 Sparse专家将能力分配到各种符号之间,重量共享控制了新增深度的参数成本,环表分配到各个噪声级别. • 支助 一种可伸缩的设计空间,用于密集和稀疏的专家传播变形器. DyLoMo-DIT尺度跨模型大小,包含DiT,MOE-DIT,并循环DiT作为特例.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Parameters without compute: sparse experts in Transformers. DiT-MoE [ 23 ] introduces per-token sparse experts into DiT. Subsequent work improves expert routing or extends sparse experts to other backbones and tasks [ 79 , 64 , 62 , 74 , 36 , 1 ] . DiffMoE and ProMoE report that token-choice sparse experts often underperform dense models when active parameter counts are matched. Another line of work assigns experts explicitly to different noise stages [ 5 , 24 , 22 , 50 , 49 , 69 , 11 ] . Our method does not use such an assignment, but Sec. 5.7 shows that its routing learns a similar split. Per-head routing has been explored in Multi-Head Mixture-of-Experts [ 75 ] , Multi-Head LatentMoE [ 14 ] , and MAGI-2 [ 59 ] . None of these methods shares weights across depth, so depth remains tied to parameter count.
blocks.zh: 不计算参数: 变形金刚体专家稀少. DiT-MoE [23] 向DiT引入了每只脚的稀疏专家. 随后的工作改善了专家的路径,或将稀疏的专家扩展到其他骨干和任务[79,64,62,74,36,1]. DiffMoE和ProMoE报告说,当活动参数计数匹配时,象征性选择的稀疏专家往往表现不佳。 另一类工作明确指派专家到不同的噪音阶段[5、24、22、50、49、69、11]。 我们的方法并不使用这样的任务,但是第5.7sec.显示它的路由学得类似的分裂. 在多头混合专家[75],多头LatentMoE[14],和MAGI-2[59]中探索了人头路线. 这些方法没有一个能分享跨深度的权重,因此深度仍然与参数数相连.

blocks.en: Depth without parameters: weight-shared Transformers. The Universal Transformer [ 17 ] applies the same transformation recurrently across depth. SMELT [ 72 ] compares looped and non-looped MoE language models at matched compute, parameter count, and KV cache, and recommends looping through roughly half of the layers—located in the middle of the network—for two passes, with residual updates scaled by 1 / r 1/r . For visual generation, Fixed Point Diffusion Models [ 4 ] incorporate fixed-point solver layers into the denoiser. ELT, Looped DiT, LiFT, and LoopREG [ 28 , 12 , 19 , 73 ] , three of which are concurrent with this work, apply loops to some or all layers of a DiT. However, they retain dense feed-forward networks, leaving parameter count tied to computation.
blocks.zh: 无参数深度:重量共享变形器. 通用变换器 [17] 重复地跨深度应用同样的变换. SMELT [72] 在匹配的计算、参数计数和 KV 缓存时比较循环和非循环的MOE 语言模型,并建议通过大约一半的层来循环——位于网络中间——对两个通过,剩余更新比例为1/r 1/r. 对于视觉生成,固定点散射模型[4]将固定点解器层融入到denoiser中. ELT、Looped DiT、LiFT和LoopREG[28、12、19、73],其中三个与这项工作同时进行,对DiT的某些或所有各层适用循环。 然而,它们保留了密集的向导网络,使参数计数与计算挂钩.

blocks.en: Removing both couplings. Several language-model studies combine sparse experts with recurrence [ 65 , 13 , 8 , 25 , 72 ] . Lee et al . [ 38 ] find that looped MoE models benefit more from scaling than the standard baseline, whereas looped dense models do not. Subsequent work explores using more passes, the roles of the two visits, scaling laws with respect to pass count, experts shared across layers, and per-token recursion depth [ 30 , 31 , 9 , 35 , 54 , 2 ] . To our knowledge, no diffusion Transformer has removed both couplings while allocating depth by noise level. This work does so under the standard DiT protocol. We evaluate multi-stream residuals [ 82 , 77 , 29 , 67 , 26 ] separately; they are not part of our method ( App. I ).
blocks.zh: 移除两个连接 。 几种语言模式研究结合了稀少的专家与复发[65,13,8,25,72]. Lee et al. [38] 发现循环式的MOE模型比标准基线更能从缩放中受益,而循环式的密集模型则没有. 随后的工作探索使用更多的通行证、两次访问的作用、扩大关于通过点数的法律、分享专家的层层以及每层重复深度[30、31、9、35、54、2]。 据我们所知,没有任何扩散变形器在按照噪音水平分配深度时去除两个耦合物。 这项工作是在标准DiT协议下完成的. 我们分别评价多流残留[82,77,29,67,26];它们不属于我们的方法(App.I).

Weight sharing adds effective depth without duplicating parameters, freeing budget for experts. DiT, MoE-DiT, and looped DiT correspond to one expert and one pass, one pass, and one expert, respectively ( Table 1 ).

Each expert is a gated feed-forward network d / H → f → d / H d/H\to f\to d/H with a gpt-oss-style [ 48 ] clamped SwiGLU [ 60 ] activation; at the XL tier, H = 4 H=4 , E = 16 E=16 , k = 6 k=6 and f = 640 f=640 , so each token activates 24 routed experts per layer (other tiers and single-head models: App. H ). blocks.en: 3.4 Depth by Noise Level: Allocating the Passes
blocks.zh: 3.4 噪声级深度: 分配通行证

blocks.en: The number of passes is a function of the noise level: the recommended schedule runs r = 3 r=3 for t < 500 t<500 and r = 1 r=1 for t ≥ 500 t\geq 500 , two passes on average over uniformly spaced sampling steps, so the mean compute equals that of two passes at every timestep while a token passes through 30 layers at low noise and 16 at high noise (XL tier). The schedule is part of the model: the timestep of each training sample decides its number of passes, sampling uses the same schedule, and a model trained under one schedule must be run under that schedule; when the number of passes is instead drawn from { 1 , 2 , 3 } \{1,2,3\} at every training step, one set of weights can be run under several schedules, so depth can be chosen at inference. Section 5.6 compares schedules; the return on extra passes ( Sec. 5.5 ) is also observed on an in-house video generation model ( App. G ).

blocks.en: 3.5 Configuring a Model for a Budget
blocks.zh: 3.5 国家 构建预算模式

blocks.en: Because the three resources share one budget, a member is configured as a whole: the width and the number of layer visits set the forward compute, matched within 1%; the loop decides how many of these visits are distinct layers (a shared middle segment of a third to a half of the layers leaves fewer physical layers than a loop-free model has at the same compute); and the number of experts fills the parameter budget, matched within about 2%, so the parameters that the loop saves go to the experts. At the budget of DiT-XL/2 (28 layers, 0.68B parameters, 118.6 GMAC), DyLoMo-DiT-XL has 16 physical layers and 23 layer visits on average; removing the loop and spending the saved parameters on independent layers gives the single-pass member at the same budget (23 layers), which Secs. 5.1 and 5.4 use to isolate the loop (all configurations: App. H ).
blocks.zh: 因为三个资源共享一个预算,所以一个成员被整体配置: 宽度和层访问次数设置了前置计算,在1%内匹配; 循环决定这些访问中有多少是不同的层(一个三分之一到一半的共享中段留下的物理层比一个无循环模型在同一个计算中留下的更少); 专家人数填充参数预算,在大约2%内匹配,因此循环节省的参数归专家所有. 在DiT-XL/2(28层,0.68B参数,118.6 GMAC)的预算上,DyLoMo-DiT-XL平均有16个物理层,23个层访问;移除循环,将节省的参数花在独立层上,使单通过成员在同一预算(23层),Secs. 5.1和5.4用来隔离循环(所有配置:App.H).

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: To ensure a fair comparison with DiT and DiT-MoE, we train all class-conditional models on ImageNet [ 18 ] using the same training setup. We also train a single text-to-image model, without ablations, to assess whether DyLoMo-DiT extends to text-conditioned generation. This model scales up the architecture in Sec. 3 : it has width 1024, 32 physical layers with the middle 16 looped, 4 routing heads with 128 experts each, 15.48B total parameters, and 1.05B active parameters per image token. It differs from the class-conditional models in three respects: text and image tokens form a single sequence, with conditioning written into each token’s input rather than injected through adaLN; it uses a 4-stream residual, which trains normally without adaLN and improves performance ( App. I ); and it is trained with the rectified-flow objective [ 43 ] .
blocks.zh: 为确保与DiT和DiT-MoE的公平比较,我们使用相同的培训设置,在ImageNet[18]上培训所有有条件的模型. 我们还训练一个单一的文本对图像模型,没有擦伤,以评估DyLoMo-DIT是否延伸到文本条件生成. 这个模型在Sec. 3中放大了建筑:它的宽度为1024,32物理层,中间16个环绕,4个路由头,每个有128位专家,总参数为15.48B,每个图像符号有1.05B活性参数. 它在三个方面与类条件模型不同:文本和图像符号组成一个单一的序列,每个符号的输入中写有条件,而不是通过adaLN注入;它使用4流残基,通常在没有adaLN的情况下进行训练,并改进性能(App.I);它接受修正流目标的培训[43].

blocks.en: Training details. All ImageNet models follow a common pipeline based on the DiT recipe: VAE latents [ 56 ] , the DDPM objective [ 33 , 47 ] , a global batch size of 256, 400k training steps, AdamW [ 44 ] with a constant learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and EMA with decay 0.9999 ( App. H ). We train the DiT baselines from scratch using the official model definitions; their unguided FID agrees with Table 4 of the DiT paper ( App. H ). We implement DiT-MoE [ 23 ] based on its public code ( Sec. 5.2 , App. J ).
blocks.zh: 培训详情。 所有ImageNet模型都遵循基于DiT配方的共同管道:VAE潜伏[56],DDPM目标[33,47],全球批量大小为256,400k训练步骤,AdamW[44],持续学习率为10−4 10^{-4},EMA为衰减0.9999(App.H). 我们使用官方模型定义从头开始训练DiT基线;其无制导的FID同意DiT文件(App.H.)表4。 我们根据其公共代码(Sec. 5.2, App.J)执行DiT-MoE[23]。

blocks.en: ImageNet-256. We evaluate class-conditional generation on ImageNet at 256 × 256 256\times 256 , following the DiT protocol [ 52 ] . We use EMA weights and sample with 250-step DDPM and classifier-free guidance [ 32 ] at scale 1.5. Every 100k training steps, we generate 50k images per checkpoint and evaluate FID, sFID [ 46 ] , IS [ 58 ] , Precision, and Recall [ 37 ] using the ADM evaluator [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: ImageNet-256 (英语). 我们评价在ImageNet上按256×256256\times 256的等级条件生成, 我们使用具有250步DDPM的EMA重量和样本,并在1.5级进行无分级制导[32]. 每100公里的训练步骤,我们每个检查站生成50公里的图像,并使用ADM评价器对FID、SFID[46]、IS[58]、精准度和召回[37]进行评价。

blocks.en: Compute matching. Because both model capacity and inference cost matter, we match each DyLoMo-DiT model to its baseline in total parameter count and forward compute, unless stated otherwise. We measure forward compute as the number of multiply-accumulates per image in one forward pass. GMAC denotes 10 9 10^{9} multiply-accumulates, counted in the same way as the Gflops reported in the DiT paper. For models with noise-dependent loop schedules, we average compute over the 250 uniformly spaced sampling steps. Parameter counts include the adaLN modulation layers, which account for about one third of DiT’s parameters while adding negligible compute; these layers are shared within the looped segment. Excluding adaLN, DyLoMo-DiT has 1.2–1.3 × \times the parameters of the DiT in the same tier ( App. B ). All reported results are means over seeds, and differences and percentages are computed from unrounded values.
blocks.zh: 计算匹配。 由于模型容量和推论成本都很重要,我们把每个DyLoMo-DIT模型在总参数计数和前置计算中与其基线相匹配,除非另有说明. 我们以每幅图像的乘积数计算前进。 GMAC表示10 9 10^{9}的乘积,与DiT文件中报告的Gflops一样计算. 对于具有依赖噪音的循环时间表的模型,我们平均计算出250个统一空间的取样步骤。 参数计数包括adaLN调制层,它占DiT参数的大约三分之一,同时添加可忽略不计的计算;这些层在循环段内共享. 除adaLN外,DyLoMo-DIT有1.2–1.3 ×\times的DiT参数在同一级(App.B.). 所有报告的结果都是对种子的表示,差异和百分比是根据未四舍五入的数值计算的。

blocks.en: Text-to-image evaluation. We report GenEval [ 27 ] ; DPG-Bench [ 34 ] and COCO FID [ 41 ] are reported in App. A . We rerun and rescore public models using the same evaluation pipeline at their native resolutions. Differences smaller than 0.03 are treated as not meaningful ( App. A ).
blocks.zh: 文本对图像评价. 我们报告GenEval[27];DPG-Bench[34]和COCO FID[41]在App.A中报告。 我们重新运行和重新建立公共模式,利用同样的评价渠道,在它们自己的分辨率。 小于0.03的区别被视为没有意义(App.A.)。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: The experiments have four stages. We first compare DyLoMo-DiT with DiT and DiT-MoE on ImageNet-256 at matched total parameters and forward compute ( Secs. 5.1 and 5.2 ), and then against scaled-up baselines ( Sec. 5.3 ). Next, we ablate the design choices and analyze the loop’s parameter–compute trade-off, the noise levels that benefit from extra passes, and the learned routing ( Secs. 5.4 , 5.5 , 5.6 and 5.7 ). Finally, we test a text-to-image model at a larger scale ( Sec. 5.8 ).
blocks.zh: 实验分为四个阶段. 我们首先将DyLoMo-DiT与DiT和DiT-MoE在ImageNet-256上的对应总参数和前置计算(第5.1和第5.2节)进行比较,然后对照扩大的基线(第5.3节)。 接下来,我们放弃设计选择,分析环线的参数 — — 计算取舍、额外通行证产生的噪音水平以及学习的路径(第5.4、5.5、5.6和5.7条 ) 。 最后,我们在更大的尺度上测试一个文本对图像模型(第5.8节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison with DiT at Equal Parameters and Compute
blocks.zh: 5.1 在等参数和计算上与 DiT 进行比较

blocks.en: At matched parameter and compute budgets, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID relative to DiT by 11%, 14%, and 24% in the B, L, and XL tiers, respectively ( Table 2 ). Its advantage grows during training: the FID ratio of DyLoMo-DiT to DiT declines from 100k to 400k steps in every tier (B: 1.05 → 0.89 1.05\rightarrow 0.89 ; L: 0.98 → 0.86 0.98\rightarrow 0.86 ; XL: 0.93 → 0.76 0.93\rightarrow 0.76 ), as shown in Figure 2 . blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with DiT-MoE at Its Own Budget
blocks.zh: 5.2 在自有预算中与DiT-MOE的比较

blocks.en: At matched total parameter counts and forward compute, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 36%, 56%, and 56% relative to DiT-MoE in the S, B, and L tiers, respectively ( Table 3 ; Fig. 2 , bottom). We compare at each DiT-MoE tier’s own budget because these models retain the width and depth of the corresponding DiT while adding experts to every layer, resulting in about six times as many parameters and 2.7 times the compute. For each tier, we configure DyLoMo-DiT to match DiT-MoE’s total parameter count and compute: one routing head, 16 experts per layer with 2 selected, 16 layers with the middle 6 looped, and the same pass allocation as above ( Sec. 3.5 ). We train DiT-MoE under the same protocol, using 16 experts per layer with 4 selected. Thus, both models have the same number of experts per layer. These results reflect our DiT-MoE implementation under this training protocol, rather than the results reported in its paper ( App. J ).
blocks.zh: 在匹配的总参数计数和前置计算时,DyLoMo-DIT比S级、B级和L级的DiT-MOE分别减少36%、56%和56%(表3;图2,下方)。 我们比较DiT-MoE的每层预算,因为这些模型保留了相应的DiT的宽度和深度,同时在每个层中增加专家,导致大约六倍的参数和2.7倍的计算. 对于每一级,我们配置DyLoMo-DIT,以匹配DiT-MoE的总参数计数和计算:1个路由头,每层16名专家,2个选定,16个层,中间6个环绕,和上面相同的通过分配(第3.5节)。 我们在同一个协议下训练DiT-MoE,每层使用16位专家,并选出4位. 因此,两种模型每层专家人数相同。 这些结果反映了我们根据这项培训议定书执行DiT-MOE的情况,而不是其文件(App.J)中所报告的结果。

blocks.en: We also evaluate the original DiT-MoE configuration, which uses 8 experts per layer, selects 2, and includes a shared expert. It obtains FIDs of 30.80, 12.91, and 7.50 in the S, B, and L tiers; DyLoMo-DiT reduces these by 36%, 46%, and 53%, respectively (XL results: Sec. 5.3 ). We further compare against ProMoE [ 74 ] . At the ProMoE-L budget and after 500k training steps, matching the schedule in its paper, DyLoMo-DiT reaches an FID of 4.05, compared with 4.86 for our ProMoE-L rerun and 5.12 as reported. At 400k steps, our ProMoE-XL rerun reaches an FID of 4.78, compared with 4.22 for DyLoMo-DiT-XL, despite using 2.3 × 2.3\times as many parameters ( App. J ).

blocks.en: 5.3 Scaling Up the Baselines
blocks.zh: 5.3 扩大基线

blocks.en: To test whether the gains can be recovered simply by increasing baseline size, we scale up DiT and DiT-MoE ( App. B ). DiT-XL/2 scaled to 1.6 × 1.6\times , 2.2 × 2.2\times , and 3.0 × 3.0\times gives FIDs of 5.22, 4.57, and 4.75. Even at three times the parameters and compute, DiT remains 13% worse than DyLoMo-DiT-XL at its original scale (4.22 FID). blocks.en: We analyze routing in the DyLoMo-DiT-XL model in Table 2 (protocol and two-pass control: App. F ).
blocks.zh: 我们在表2(protocol和双路口控制:App.F.)中分析DyLoMo-DIT-XL模型中的路由.

blocks.en: The second pass reuses most of the experts. On the second pass, each token reuses an average of 4.61 of the 6 experts per head selected on the first pass, compared with 2.57 for the same position in another image and 2.25 under random selection. The two passes also produce similarly directed residual writes, with cosine similarities of 0.68 for attention and 0.62 for feed-forward networks. These aligned writes motivate the 1 / r 1/r scaling across passes in Sec. 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 第二传复用大部分专家. 在第二次通过时,每枚令牌平均重复使用第一次通过时每名被选中的6位专家中的4.61位,而另一个图像中同一职位的回用为2.57位,随机选择为2.25位. 这两段传记还产生了类似定向的残余书写,其余弦相似度分别为0.68用于关注,0.62用于向导网络. 这些对齐的书写激励着第3.3节的1 / r 1/r 跨度缩放。

blocks.en: Routing specializes by noise level and can switch between adjacent steps. Across adjacent timesteps within either t ≤ 550 t\leq 550 or t ≥ 650 t\geq 650 , the expert distribution changes little (JS divergence of about 0.005 nats). Between t = 550 t=550 and t = 650 t=650 , it shifts sharply, reaching 0.30, and every layer switches ( App. F ). On a finer grid with step size 10, the switch occurs between t = 550 t=550 and t = 560 t=560 (JS divergence 0.287); all other adjacent pairs on this grid have divergence at most 0.0005. Experts specialize across the two ranges: 47% receive more than 80% of their calls in one range ( Fig. 7 b), compared with 36% in the two-pass control ( App. F ). The number of active experts also falls from 15.0 at t = 50 t=50 to 9.2 at t = 950 t=950 .
blocks.zh: 运行方式通过噪声级别进行专门化,可以在相邻步骤之间切换. 在550 t\leq 550或650 t\geq 650之间的相邻时间段,专家分布变化不大(JS差异约为0.005纳特)。 在 t = 550 t = 550 和 t = 650 t = 650 之间,它急转直下,达到0.30,每层开关(App. F.). 在步长为10的更细网格上,开关发生在 t = 550 t = 550和 t = 560 t = 560 (JS difference 02.87)之间;这个网格上所有其他相邻的对子最多有0.0005. 专家的专业范围跨越两个范围:47%的人在一个范围收到80%以上的电话(图7b),而在双通道控制(App.F.)中则收到36%的电话。 在职专家人数也从15.0 at t = 50 t = 50 t 降至9.2 at t = 950 t = 950 .

blocks.en: The router receives no explicit timestep input; timestep information reaches it only through adaLN-modulated features, and the learned timestep embedding itself changes abruptly where the routing switches, unlike that of DiT ( App. F ). The routing switch does not align with the pass-allocation boundary at t = 500 t=500 (the JS divergence from t = 499 t=499 to t = 500 t=500 is 0.002), and a model without the loop also switches within one step ( App. F ). These findings suggest that the router’s noise-level specialization is learned from its input features, rather than imposed by the pass schedule or the loop.
blocks.zh: 路由器没有获得明确的时间步输入;时间步信息仅通过adaLN调制的特性到达它,学到的时间步嵌入本身在路由开关的地方突然变化,与DiT(App.F.)不同. 路由开关不与通过分配边界在 t = 500 t = 500 (JS从 t = 499 t = 499 t = 500 t = 500 t = 500 = 0.02)一致,没有环线的模型也在一步内开关(App. F.). 这些调查结果表明,路由器的噪声级专门化是从它的输入特性中学习的,而不是由路由表或环所强加的.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: DyLoMo-DiT improves matched-budget efficiency by combining sparse experts with weight-shared recurrence, with further gains from dynamically assigning more passes to low-noise steps. Routers also learn noise-level specialization without explicit timestep inputs. On ImageNet, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11–24% versus DiT and 36–56% versus DiT-MoE at matched budgets; at equal compute, it outperforms DiT-MoE-B with less than one third of its parameters, and a DiT with three times the parameters and compute remains 13% behind; at 1.6M steps, it surpasses the FID reported for DiT-XL/2 after 7M steps. Scaled up to 15B parameters, it becomes a production-scale text-to-image model that scores above FLUX.1 on GenEval with less than one tenth of its active parameters, and it transfers to video ( App. C ).
blocks.zh: DyLoMo-DIT通过将人数稀少的专家与重量分担的重现相结合,提高相应预算的效率,从动态地为低噪音步骤分配更多的通行证而进一步受益。 路由器也学习噪音级的专业化,而没有明确的时序输入. 在ImageNet上,DyLoMo-DIT在相匹配的预算中将FID减少11–24%,比DiT-MoE减少36–56%;在等价计算中,它以不到三分之一的参数比DiT-MoE-B表现优于DiT-MoE-B,一个参数和计算量三倍的DiT仍然落后13%;在1.6M步骤中,它超过了在7M步骤后为DiT-XL/2报告的FID. 其规模可达15B参数,成为生产规模的文本到图像模型,在GenEval上以不到其有效参数的十分之一评分超过FLUX.1,并转录到视频(App. C.).

blocks.en: This appendix gives the details behind Sec. 4 (text-to-image setup) and Sec. 5.8 , and lists the prompts of the head figure ( ). The experiment asks whether the same architecture carries over from class-conditional generation on ImageNet to text-to-image; only one model is trained, with no ablation. Images are encoded with the Wan2.2 VAE [ 69 ] and text with a frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 3 ] ; sampling uses 50 Euler steps with APG [ 57 ] at guidance scale 5.

blocks.en: The first and last layers use dense feed-forward networks, and the 30 layers in between use sparse-expert feed-forward networks; each token selects 6 experts per head, and there is one always-on shared expert (width 1280). The looped segment is the middle 16 layers, with 8 layers before it and 8 after it, so one forward pass executes 8 + 16 × 2 + 8 = 48 8+16\times 2+8=48 layers. Active parameters are counted as follows: the layers of the looped segment are counted once; the routers, which score all experts, are counted in full; the image input and output adapter layers are counted once. The timestep is written into the first 64 channels of the input as a 64-dimensional sinusoidal encoding.
blocks.zh: 第一层和最后一层使用密集的向导网络,30层在使用稀疏的专家向导网络之间;每个信使每头选择6位专家,有一个总是共享的专家(width 1280). 环绕的段是中间的16层,前有8层,后有8层,因此一个前传执行8+16×2+8=48 8+16\times 2+8=48层. 活性参数计算如下: 循环段的层数计算一次; 路由器(所有专家的得分)全部计算一次; 图像输入和输出适配器层数计算一次. 时间步被写入输入的前64个通道,作为64维的sinusoidal编码.

blocks.en: The VAE has 48 channels and downsamples spatially by 16 × 16\times ; there is no further patching, so one latent position is one token. Text features are taken from the output of the third-to-last layer of the text encoder, before its final normalization layer, with at most 1,000 tokens.

blocks.en: The public models are models with open weights and a published GenEval score, covering 0.6B to 12B denoiser parameters and including FLUX.1 [ 6 ] (12B), the strongest open dense model of a scale close to ours. The sampling settings of each model are: SDXL [ 53 ] , 50 steps, guidance scale 9.0 (the value in the official GenEval example script); SD 1.5 [ 56 ] , 50 steps, 7.5; PixArt- α \alpha [ 7 ] , 20 steps, 4.5; Sana-1.6B [ 76 ] , 20 steps, 4.5; FLUX.1-dev [ 6 ] , 50 steps, 3.5; FLUX.1-schnell, 4 steps, no guidance. blocks.en: Trained on to 1M steps under the same protocol, DyLoMo-DiT-XL and DiT-XL/2 reach 2.46 and 3.08 ( Tables B2 and B1 ). The FID of DyLoMo-DiT-XL decreases monotonically from 500k to 1M steps (3.60, 3.19, 2.91, 2.71, 2.59, 2.46), and its ratio to DiT-XL/2 stays between 0.76 and 0.80 over the six evaluation points. At the budget of DiT-MoE-B ( Table 3 ), DyLoMo-DiT trained on to 1M steps reaches 3.41; its FID decreases monotonically over the six evaluation points (5.72, 4.78, 4.32, 3.86, 3.57 and 3.41 from 500k to 1M steps; 7.01 at 400k). The original configuration of DiT-MoE-B, continued to 500k steps, gives 10.45: DyLoMo-DiT is 45% below it at 500k steps, after 46% at 400k steps (12.91, Sec. 5.2 ).

blocks.en: The two XL runs of Table B2 were continued further under the same protocol. DyLoMo-DiT-XL is 18% below DiT-XL/2 at both points, and the ratio of the two FIDs is 0.82 at both, after 0.80 at 1M steps, so the relative gap is stable from 1.6M to 2.2M steps. Each of these points is one run per model.
blocks.zh: 根据同一协议,表B2的两次XL运行进一步继续进行。 在1.6M步,DyLoMo-DiT-XL和DiT-XL/2达到2.18和2.67(图4);在2.2M步,达到2.07和2.52. DyLoMo-DiT-XL在两个点上都低于DiT-XL/2的18%,两个FID在两个点上的比例为0.82,在1M步0.80之后,因此相对差距从1.6M步稳定到2.2M步. 这些点数中每个模型都有一个运行.

blocks.en: At the XL tier the gains continue beyond four passes ( Fig. B4 ): the model with 16 experts per head (0.69B) gives 5.94, 4.36, 4.29, 3.96 and 3.85 with one, two, three, four and eight passes, four passes being 9% below two and eight passes 2.6% below four, and the variant with 32 experts per head (1.13B) gives 5.49, 4.21, 3.81 and 3.65 from one to four. The return diminishes: from two to four passes the compute rises from 1.0 × 1.0\times to 1.6 × 1.6\times that of DiT-XL/2 and FID falls by 0.40, whereas from four to eight it rises from 1.6 × 1.6\times to 2.9 × 2.9\times and FID falls by 0.10. The eight-pass model is at 21.81, 8.13, 5.05 and 3.85 after 100k, 200k, 300k and 400k steps ( Table B3 ).

blocks.en: In Table 3 , all four evaluation points go the same way in every tier, with the gap widening from S to B and similar in B and L: the ratio of the FID of DyLoMo-DiT to that of DiT-MoE goes from 0.80 at 100k steps to 0.64 at 400k in the S tier, from 0.62 to 0.44 in B and from 0.56 to 0.44 in L ( Table B5 ). blocks.en: This appendix supports the statement of Secs. 1 and 6 that the design transfers to video. It tests whether the weights of the text-to-image model of Sec. 5.8 can serve directly as the starting point for video generation. The architecture is unchanged and no parameters are added; the input becomes video latents: an 81-frame video is encoded by the same VAE into 21 latent frames, 9,408 tokens per video. The task is image-to-video: the first latent frame is kept clean and excluded from the loss, which covers only the remaining 20 frames. Training uses an in-house video set, with a separate held-out portion as the validation set; the video stage loads weights only from an image checkpoint, with a global batch of 96 videos, learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} and cosine decay. Evaluation uses the validation loss and a small number of sample videos.

blocks.en: This appendix supports the statement of Sec. 1 that the design scales in the text-to-image setting ( Sec. 5.8 ). It tests whether the same architecture keeps improving with more parameters across scales. All three scales use the architecture of the text-to-image model (the middle half of the layers executed in two passes, sparse experts routed per head, and a multi-stream residual with 4 streams), changing only the width, the number of layers and the number of experts ( Table E1 ). All are trained from random initialization for 6,000 steps with the same data, batch and learning-rate schedule; the validation set is fixed, and the timestep and noise of every image are fixed and identical across the three scales sample by sample. For each scale a control without multi-stream residual is also trained. We report the validation loss at 6,000 steps.

blocks.en: Prior step-wise adaptive computation in diffusion models acts at inference: AdaDiff [ 66 ] exits early at some timesteps, DyDiT [ 80 ] changes the width per timestep, and DDSM [ 78 ] selects a network size per step. The allocation of passes here is part of the model and of its training, and total parameters and mean compute stay equal to those of the baseline.

blocks.en: A looped model spends its sampling compute on passes; a single-pass model can spend the same compute on more sampling steps. To separate the two, the XL models trained with one to four passes at every timestep ( Table B3 ) are each sampled with their own pass count and with the number of DDPM steps set so that the total compute of sampling, the number of steps times the compute of one forward pass, is equal across pass counts ( Table G2 ): equal to two passes at 250 steps (29.4 TMAC per image) and to four passes at 250 steps (48.0 TMAC per image), within 0.4%. The outcome is the same at both budgets: at equal sampling compute, the compute is better spent on passes than on steps. At 29.4 TMAC, four passes at 153 steps give 3.91 against 4.36 for two passes at 250 steps and 5.85 for one pass at 365; at 48.0 TMAC, four passes at 250 steps give 3.96, three passes at 310 steps 4.33, two at 407 steps 4.41 and one at 594 steps 5.89. The number of steps is saturated in this range: at a fixed pass count, FID moves by at most 0.10 between 150 and 600 steps and without a monotone trend (one pass: 5.94, 5.85, 5.88 and 5.89 at 250, 365, 500 and 594 steps), so a single-pass model does not close the gap by taking more steps. All points are single seeds from the 400k checkpoints of Table B3 ; differences below 0.1 are within noise. Guidance doubles the forward passes of every point alike and is left out of the counts.
blocks.zh: 循环模型将其采样计算用在通行证上;单通道模型可以将同样的计算用在更多的采样步骤上. 为将两者分开,每一步经过1至4次通过训练的XL型号(表B3),每个取样时都有自己的通行证计数和DDPM步骤数,这样,抽样总计算,一步数为前传数的计算数,在0.4%。 结果在两个预算中都是一样的:在同等抽样计算时,计算在通行证上比在台阶上花得更好。 在29.4 TMAC,153步的4个通行证给3.91对4.36,250步的2个通行证给5.85,365步的1个通行证给5.85;在48.0 TMAC,250步的4个通行证给3.96,3个通行证给310步4.33,2个通行证给407步4.41,1个通行证给594步5.89. 步数在这个范围内饱和:在固定的通过计数中,FID在150至600步间移动最多0.10步,没有单调趋势(一个通过:5.94,5.85,5.88和5.89步250,365,500和594步),所以单调的通过模式不会通过采取更多步骤来弥补差距. 所有点都是表B3400k检查站的单一种子;0.1以下的差异存在于噪音之内。 指导使每一点的前进通道都翻了一番,并且被排除在计数之外。

blocks.en: The method places the looped segment in the middle of the backbone (layers 5–11 at the XL tier). On the XL variant with 32 experts per head and two passes at every timestep, we additionally train three other placements: the looped segment at the front (layers 2–8), at the back (layers 9–15), and a model that keeps only 12 physical layers and loops all of them. The first two only move the looped segment and leave the architecture unchanged. The middle is best: 4.21, against 4.63 at the front, 4.70 at the back and 4.72 with all layers looped ( Table G4 ).
blocks.zh: 该方法将环绕的片段置于骨干中间(层5–11位于XL级). 在XL变体上,每台有32位专家,每台有2位专家通过,我们额外训练了另外3个位置:前部的环路段(层2-8),后部的环路段(层9-15),以及仅保留12个物理层并环绕全部的模型. 前两个只移动环绕的段,使架构保持不变. 中间最好:4.21,对前部4.63,后部4.70,各层环绕4.72(表G4.

blocks.en: The return on extra passes at fixed parameters ( Sec. 5.5 ) is also observed on a separate in-house video generation model: image-to-video, 24 layers, 64 experts per head, with the multi-stream residual of App. I , 2.87B parameters in total, looping layers 7 to 18. At every training step the number of passes is drawn uniformly at random from { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } \{1,2,3,4\} , for 10B tokens in total. The same weights are then evaluated with one to four passes by the validation loss on 2,000 held-out video clips (the flow-matching [ 42 ] mean squared error, with fixed noise, so the four settings are comparable per sample; Table G5 ). With each additional pass the gain falls to about three tenths of the previous one: the third pass executes 33% more layers and lowers the validation loss by 0.0036; the fourth adds another 25% and lowers it by 0.0011.
blocks.zh: 在固定参数(Sec. 5.5 )下的额外通行证返回,也通过单独的内部视频生成模型观察到:图像到视频,24层,每头64位专家,App的多流残存. I, 2.87B 参数合计,循环层7到18. 在每一个训练步骤上,通行证的号码都从{1,2,3,4}的{1,2,3,4}中随机抽取,共计10B个标志. 同样的权重随后通过2000个被搁置的视频短片的验证损失(流量比对[42] 表示平方误差,有固定的噪音,因此四个设置每个样本是可比较的;表G5)进行1到4次评估. 每增加一次,收益降至前一次的十分之三:第三次通过执行的层数增加33%,验证损失减少0.0036;第四次增加25%,降低0.0011。

blocks.en: Two points bear on reading Table G5 . During training each of the four settings received only a quarter of the steps, and the single pass is diluted the most, so the decrease at the second pass is inflated (when the same architecture is trained with the pass count drawn only from { 1 , 2 } \{1,2\} , this term is 0.0074); the increments at the third and fourth passes are diluted about equally on both sides of the comparison and can be compared with each other. The differences in the table are obtained by spending more compute on the same weights and are not a comparison at equal compute; the ImageNet models trained separately at a fixed number of passes ( Fig. 6 b, Fig. B4 ) show the same diminishing return. In addition, LOOM [ 30 ] , with a separate router and residual scaling per pass, still gains from pushing the loop beyond five passes in language models, so the diminishing return at the third and fourth passes may depend on the recipe and need not be a limit of looping itself.
blocks.zh: 阅读表G5有两点意义。 在训练期间,四个设置中每个都只获得四分之一的台阶,单次通过被稀释得最多,因此第二次通过时的减少被膨胀(当同一个架构训练时,只从{1,2}{1,2\}}中抽取出通行证数时,这个术语是0.074;第三次和第四次通过时的递增数在比较的两侧均被平均稀释,可以相互比较. 表中的差异是通过在相同的权重上花费更多的计算得到的,而不是在等量计算时的比较;在固定的通行证数(图6b,图B4)下单独训练的ImageNet模型显示同样的递减回报. 此外,LOOM [30],每段路由器和剩余缩放,在语言模型中仍能将环线推向5个路由之外,因此,第三和第四段路由的递减回报可能依赖于食谱,不需要成为环线本身的限制.

blocks.en: The input is the VAE latent, split into 2 × 2 2\times 2 patches and linearly projected into tokens; the timestep embedding and the class embedding are summed into a conditioning vector c c , which every sublayer injects through adaLN-Zero; positional information is supplied by rotary position embeddings [ 63 ] inside attention; the output layer predicts the noise and the variance. All normalization in the network is RMSNorm, applied once each to q q and k k ; the DiT baselines keep the official implementation. The rotary position encoding is a two-dimensional Fourier RoPE with 16 frequency bands, rotating only the first 3 / 4 3/4 of the dimensions of each attention head; the sigmoid gate of each attention head reads the normalized input. Normalization is computed in FP32 with eps = 10 − 6 =10^{-6} .
blocks.zh: 输入是VAE潜伏,分为2×2 2\times 2补丁,线性投射成符号;时间步嵌入和类嵌入被归纳成一个条件矢量c c ,每个子层通过adalN-Zero注入;位置信息由旋转位置嵌入在注意力内[63]提供;输出层预测噪音和差异. 网络中的所有正常化都是RMSNorm,每套应用一次qq和kk;DiT基线保留了正式执行. 旋转位置编码是一个二维的Fourier RoPE,有16个频段,每个注意力头的尺寸只旋转前 3 / 4 3/4;每个注意力头的sigmoid门读取常态输入. 正常化在FP32中计算,eps=10 - 6 = 10 - 6 }。

blocks.en: Router weights are drawn from a normal distribution with standard deviation 0.02. The experts’ up-projection has standard deviation 256 − 1 / 2 256^{-1/2} and the down-projection f − 1 / 2 f^{-1/2} . The remaining linear layers have standard deviation equal to the input dimension to the power − 1 / 2 -1/2 , none with bias; the exceptions are the adaLN modulation layers (with bias, zero-initialized) and the patch embedding layer (PyTorch default initialization, with bias). The load-balancing biases start at zero. The RMSNorm w w , the attention sink and the output layer are also zero-initialized. The timestep and class embeddings use the PyTorch default initialization.
blocks.zh: 路由器权重从标准偏差0.02的正态分布中抽取. 专家的上期预测有标准偏差256 - 1 / 2 256 - 1/2}和下期预测 f - 1 / 2 f - 1/2}。 其余的线性层的标准偏差等于功率的输入维度−1 / 2 -1/2,无偏差;例外的是adaLN调制层(带有偏差,零初始化)和补丁嵌入层(PyTorch默认初始化,带有偏差). 负载平衡偏差从零开始. RMSNorm w w,注意力槽和输出层也是零初始化的. 时间步和类嵌入使用PyTorch默认初始化.

blocks.en: The constant α = 4.9 \alpha=4.9 that multiplies the normalized routing weights in Sec. 3.2 is the default of the implementation and was not tuned.
blocks.zh: α=4.9\alpha=4.9的常数乘以第3.2节中常态的路由权重。

blocks.en: The experts, the shared expert and the dense feed-forward networks of the first and last layers all use a clamped SwiGLU: the gate branch g g is clipped to at most 7, the other branch u u is clipped to [ − 7 , 7 ] [-7,7] , and the output is g ⋅ σ ⁡ ( 1.702 ⋅ g ) ⋅ ( u + 1 ) g\cdot\sigma(1.702\cdot g)\cdot(u+1) . This SwiGLU [ 60 ] variant with clipping and a residual term appears in gpt-oss [ 48 ] .
blocks.zh: 专家、共享专家和第一层和最后一层密集的饲料推进网络都使用一个夹住的SwiGLU:闸门分支g被剪到最多7个,另一个分支uu被剪到[−7,7][7,7],输出为g\\\(1.702 + g)\(u+1) g\cdot\sigma(1.702\cdot g)\cdot(u+1). 此 SwiGLU [60] 变体带有剪接和剩余词出现于 gpt-oss [48].

blocks.en: Images are encoded with sd-vae-ft-ema [ 56 ] with scaling factor 0.18215 into 32 × 32 × 4 32\times 32\times 4 latents. Training uses a global batch of 256 for 400k steps, AdamW [ 44 ] with β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) , a constant learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , no weight decay, and an EMA coefficient of 0.9999. DDPM [ 33 ] uses a 1000-step linear noise schedule, predicting the noise and learning the variance [ 47 ] ; evaluation follows Sec. 4 , using ADM’s [ 20 ] TensorFlow evaluator and reference statistics.
blocks.zh: 图像用sd-vae-ft-ema[56]编码,缩放系数0.18215为32×32×4 32\times 32\times 4潜伏. 训练采用全球256批400k步,亚当W[44]带β=(0.9,0.999)\β=(0.9,0.999),常学习率10−4 10^{-4},不减重,EMA系数0.999. DDPM [33] 使用1000步线性噪声表,预测噪声并学习差异[47];评价遵循第4节,使用ADM的[20] Tensor. 流动评估和参考统计。

blocks.en: Appendix I Full Results for the Multi-Stream Residual
blocks.zh: 附录一 多层残基的全部结果

blocks.en: This appendix gives the evaluation of the multi-stream residual that Sec. 2 and Sec. 4 refer to: on ImageNet it is on par when training completes normally but makes training unstable together with adaLN, so it is not part of the method; without adaLN it trains normally and brings a gain, so the text-to-image model keeps it.
blocks.zh: 本附录给出了Sec. 2和Sec. 4提到的多流残留的评价:在ImageNet上,当训练正常完成但与adaLN一起使训练不稳定时,它处于平价状态,因此它不是方法的一部分;没有adaLN它就正常训练并带来收益,因此文本到图像模型保持了它.

blocks.en: Hyper-Connections [ 82 ] widen the residual stream into several streams and learn the connections between them; its appendix reports on DiT-XL/2 that static HC (SHC × \times 2) improves FID from 2.36 to 2.18 (a baseline with FP16 and QK normalization, 1400 epochs, guidance scale 1.5). mHC [ 77 ] constrains the mixing matrix between streams to be doubly stochastic; oHC [ 29 ] constrains it to the rotation group and parameterizes it with a pair of unit quaternions; other models fix it to the identity (iHC), such as the language model Hy4-preview [ 67 ] and Chimera [ 26 ] . The experiments of mHC and oHC are only on language models. In diffusion models, MAGI-2 [ 59 ] uses mHC; Chimera uses iHC together with sparse experts and reports that both improve the compute efficiency of pretraining (measured by the compute needed to reach the same training loss); Liang et al . [ 40 ] compare single-stream and four-stream mHC on ImageNet-256 and find that the gain depends on the prediction target: at the B tier in pixel space, FID goes from 10.19 to 9.78 with x x -prediction and from 139.83 to 25.36 with v v -prediction. We evaluate oHC separately as an optional component on top of DyLoMo-DiT, with the results below.
blocks.zh: Hyper-Connections [82] 将残流拓宽到几个溪流中并学习它们之间的联系;其关于静态HC(SHC ×\times)的附录报告 2) 将FID从2.36改进为2.18(基线为FP16和QK正常化,1400个时代,指导尺度1.5)。 mHC [77] 限制溪流之间的混杂矩阵具有双层结构; oHC [29] 将其限制在旋转组上,并以一对单位之四参数化; 其他模型将其固定在身份(iHC)上,例如语言模型Hy4-preview [67]和Chimera [26]. mHC和oHC的实验只针对语言模型. 在扩散模型中,MAGI-2[59]使用mHC;Chimera与稀少的专家一起使用iHC,并报告说两者都提高了预训的计算效率(用达到同样培训损失所需的计算来衡量);Liang等人[40]在ImageNet-256上比较单流和四流mHC,发现收益取决于预测目标:在像素空间的B级,FID从10.19到9.78加上x预测,从139.83到25.36加上v预测. 我们在DyLoMo-DIT之上单独评价OHC作为可选组成部分,结果如下.

blocks.en: The DyLoMo-DiT of this paper has no multi-stream residual. We additionally trained versions with oHC, in which the residual stream is widened to 4 streams mixed by an SO ⁡ ( 4 ) \mathrm{SO}(4) rotation, with the training and evaluation protocol unchanged and 1.2% more compute. These experiments were run on the XL family with 32 experts per head and two passes at every timestep (1.13B parameters; App. B ) and on its ablations. When training completes normally, the version with oHC is on par with the version without: the final FID is 4.20, against 4.21 without. Under this recipe, however, training with oHC is unstable: of the 9 runs across the arms with oHC, 7 have FID rising rather than falling at later evaluation points (back up to tens, at most over three hundred); in the 11 runs of these arms without oHC (9 at the XL tier, 2 at the L tier), FID decreases monotonically with training steps. In these abnormal runs the model itself degrades in the same way: the quality of individual images drops while diversity does not. Evaluating the abnormal checkpoints directly with the raw (non-EMA) weights gives FID from 23.96 to 46.24, Precision from 0.43 to 0.58 and Recall from 0.62 to 0.69; the normally completed checkpoints give 7.03 to 10.50, 0.70 to 0.74 and 0.55 to 0.59 respectively. In 2 of these runs (300.19 and 255.67) the EMA weights collapse further on top of this, with FID in the hundreds and Recall close to 0. The phenomenon also appears in the arms with dense feed-forward and no routing, so it does not depend on the routing of the sparse experts. We therefore did not include oHC in the method proper.
blocks.zh: 本文的DyLoMo-DIT没有多流残留. 我们通过 oHC 补充训练的版本, 将残流扩展为 4 个流, 由 SO( 4 )\ mathrm{SO} (4) 旋转, 这些实验是在XL家族上进行的,每头有32位专家,每一步有2个通过(1.13B参数;App.B参数),并在它的堆积物上进行. 当训练正常完成时,与oHC的版本与未完成的版本相同:最终FID为4.20,而未完成的版本为4.21. 然而,在这种配方下,使用OHC的训练是不稳定的:在9个配有OHC的双臂中,7个配有FID上升,而不是在后来的评价点下降(回溯到几十个,最多超过300个);在11个配有OHC的双臂(XL级9个,L级2个)中,FID随着训练步骤单调减少。 在这些异常运行中,模型本身以同样的方式降解:单个图像的质量下降而多样性却不下降. 直接用原(非EMA)重量评估异常检查站,可得到23.96至46.24、0.43至0.58和0.62至0.69的精确度;正常完成的检查站分别给予7.03至10.50、0.70至0.74和0.55至0.59。 在其中的两次运行(300.19和255.67)中,EMA的重量进一步在此之上崩溃,FID在上百,Recall接近0. 这种现象也出现在臂部中,呈密集的向前进的饲料,没有路由,因此它不依赖于稀少的专家的路由. 因此,我们没有将oHC纳入方法本身。

blocks.en: In our experiments the instability appears only when oHC is used together with adaLN. With the optimizer recipe unchanged (no weight decay, no gradient clipping, no learning-rate decay) and only the conditioning changed to a single addition at the input instead of adaLN, all 7 runs with oHC train without the instability (the no-loop model among them was trained only to 200k, with both evaluation points still decreasing), FID decreases monotonically in each, and oHC helps: two runs of the full model reach FID 5.01 and 5.17 at 400k, below the 5.67 without oHC. The text-to-image model likewise does not use adaLN and therefore includes this component; its optimizer additionally uses weight decay and gradient clipping, and the phenomenon did not occur during its training.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,不稳定性只出现在OHC与adaLN一起使用时. 由于最优化的配方没有改变(没有重量衰减,没有梯度剪切,没有学习率衰减),只有条件在输入时改为单次添加,而不是adaLN,所有7次都使用没有不稳定性的oHC列车运行(其中的不开放型号只训练到200k,两个评价点仍然在下降),FID在每一次中单调下降,OHC帮助:两次运行全型号达到FID 5.01和5.17,400k,低于没有oHC的5.67. 文字到图像模型同样不使用adaLN,因此包括这一组件;其优化器还使用了重量衰减和梯度剪切法,这一现象在训练期间没有发生.

blocks.en: This appendix documents the DiT-MoE baseline of Sec. 4 and Secs. 5.2 and 5.3 : its two configurations (both in the S, B and L tiers; the original one also at XL), how the implementation was checked against the released code, how our training differs from the recipe of the DiT-MoE paper, and what two independent works report for the same kind of routing.

blocks.en: Table J1 : The two DiT-MoE configurations under our protocol (ImageNet-256, 400k steps, EMA weights, guidance scale 1.5, 50k images) and the DyLoMo-DiT configured for the same total parameters and compute ( Table 3 ). Both configurations keep the width, depth and attention heads of the DiT of the same name and have one always-on shared expert; within a tier they have the same expert parameters and differ only in the size of the router. “—”: not trained.
blocks.zh: 表J1:我们协议下的两个DiT-MoE配置(ImageNet-256,400k步,EMA权重,制导尺度1.5,50k图像)和DyLoMo-DiT配置相同总参数和计算(表3). 两种配置都保留同名的DiT的宽度、深度和注意力头,并有一个总是共享的专家;在一个级别内,它们具有相同的专家参数,并且只在路由器的大小上有所不同。 " - " :没有经过培训。

blocks.en: DiT-MoE is implemented from the code released by its authors [ 23 ] . A model keeps the width, depth and attention heads of the DiT of the same name; the feed-forward network of every layer is replaced by routed experts plus one shared expert, with SwiGLU experts. The router takes a softmax over the experts, selects those with the highest probability and weights them by the probabilities without renormalization; the shared expert is computed for every token with weight 1. Load balancing uses an expert-level auxiliary loss with coefficient 0.005, the value in the text of the DiT-MoE paper (the default of the released code is 0.01), with statistics computed locally in each data-parallel process. The training protocol, optimizer, EMA, sampling and evaluation are those of all other models ( Sec. 4 ). We train two configurations ( Table J1 ). The original configuration has 8 experts per layer with 2 selected, each of intermediate width 4 ​ d 4d , and a shared expert of width 2 ​ d 2d (the released code implements the two shared experts of the paper as one feed-forward network of this width). The second configuration cuts every expert in two: 16 experts per layer of width 2 ​ d 2d with 4 selected and the same shared expert, so that total parameters, active parameters and compute are unchanged up to the router; it has the number of experts per layer of the DyLoMo-DiT it is compared with in Table 3 . At the B tier, the original configuration (12.91) is 20% below the configuration with 16 experts (16.06), and DyLoMo-DiT (7.01) is 46% and 56% below the two. At the S tier the two configurations are level: the original one gives 30.80 and the one with 16 experts 30.83, and DyLoMo-DiT (19.79) is 36% below both, so the advantage of the original configuration at the B tier does not carry over to the S tier. At the L tier the original configuration is at 34.23, 16.38, 10.33 and 7.50 after 100k, 200k, 300k and 400k steps, against 35.64, 17.27, 10.94 and 7.92 for the configuration with 16 experts, so it is 5% below at 400k, and DyLoMo-DiT (3.50) is 53% and 56% below the two. Over the three tiers the original configuration is therefore level with or below the one with 16 experts, and DyLoMo-DiT is 36%, 46% and 53% below the stronger of the two at S, B and L.
blocks.zh: DiT-MoE从其作者发布的代码中执行 [23]. 一个模型保留了同名的DiT的宽度,深度和注意力头;每层的向导网络被路由专家+1名共享专家所取代,由SwiGLU专家. 路由器在专家之上取一个软max,选择概率最高的人,并按概率进行加权,而不恢复正常;共享的专家按重量计算每个符号. 1. 负载平衡使用一个专家级辅助损失,系数为0.005,即DiT-MoE纸文本中的值(所释放代码的默认值为0.01),每个数据并行过程中的统计都在当地计算. 培训协议、优化器、EMA、取样和评价是所有其他模式的(第4节)。 我们训练两个配置(表J1). 原配置每层有8位专家,选取2位,中间宽度分别为4 d 4d ,宽度为2 d 2d 的共享专家(发布代码将论文的2位共享专家作为这一宽度的1个向导网络执行). 第二组配置将每位专家分成两组:每层宽度2 d 2d 的16位专家,其中4位被选定,同一位共享专家,这样总参数,活性参数和计算直到路由器都保持不变;它拥有DyLoMo-DIT每层的专家人数,与表3中的比较. 在B级,原配置(12.91)低于配置20%,拥有16名专家(16.06),DyLoMo-DIT(7.01)低于46%和56%. 在S级,两种配置是级别:原始配置给出30.80个,专家16人30.83个;DyLoMo-DIT(19.79个)均低于36%,因此B级的原始配置优势不会结转到S级. 在L级,最初的配置为34.23、16.38、10.33和100k、200k、300k和400k之后的7.50级,而配置为35.64、17.27、10.94和7.92级,拥有16名专家,因此低于400k的5%,DyLoMo-DIT(3.50)低于53%和56%。 因此,在三个层次上,原有的配置与16名专家的配置相同或较低,而S、B和L的DyLoMo-DIT的配置则分别为36%、46%和53%。

blocks.en: The DiT-MoE models of Sec. 5.3 use the same code (costs and FID over training: Tables B3 and B1 ). Scaled down to the budget of DiT-XL/2, DiT-MoE has width 1024 and 3 experts per layer with 2 selected (expert width 536, shared expert 2768; 7.90). At the compute of DiT-XL/2 with more parameters, it has width 1152 and 8 experts with 2 selected, either with experts of width 768 and a shared expert as wide as the two selected experts together (1536; 1.7 × 1.7\times the parameters, 9.19) or with the proportions of the released code, in which the shared expert is half as wide as a routed expert (1232 and 616; 2.1 × 2.1\times , 10.61). The model scaled to 2.2 × 2.2\times in both parameters and compute has width 1536 (expert width 808, shared expert 4136; 6.65), and the original XL configuration has experts of width 4608 and a shared expert of width 2304 (4.17B parameters, 328.0 GMAC; 6.87). Without guidance, the two eight-expert models at the compute of DiT-XL/2 reach 26.89 and 29.24 at 400k steps, against 18.91 for DiT-XL/2 ( Table H3 ).

blocks.en: The DiT-MoE paper trains with a batch size of 1024 for 500k, 1M and 7M iterations and reports, with guidance and after long training, an FID of 1.72 for its XL configuration against 2.27 for DiT-XL/2. Our runs use the protocol of all other models in this paper (batch 256, 400k steps, DDPM, 250 sampling steps, guidance scale 1.5). The DiT-MoE numbers of this paper therefore characterize its recipe under this protocol and say nothing about the results in its paper. Training every model under one protocol is also what ProMoE [ 74 ] and DiffMoE [ 62 ] do when they compare with this kind of routing; both in addition reconfigure the sparse-expert baselines to the active parameters of the dense model, whereas Sec. 5.2 keeps the width, depth, routing, shared expert and auxiliary loss of DiT-MoE and configures our model for its budget.
blocks.zh: DiT-MoE纸质列车的批量尺寸为1024辆,用于500k,1M和7M的迭代和报告,在引导下,经过长时间训练后,其XL配置的FID为1.72,而DiT-XL/2. 我们的运行使用本文中所有其他模型的协议(批次256,400k步,DDPM,250个采样步,指导尺度1.5). 因此,本文的DiT-MOE数字是其根据本议定书制定的配方的特点,在文件中对结果不作任何说明。 在一个协议下培训每个模型也是ProMoE[74]和DiffMoE[62]在与这种路由进行比较时所做的;此外,两者都将稀有专家基线重新配置为密集模型的有效参数,而第5.2条保留DiT-MoE的宽度、深度、路由、共享专家和辅助损失,并配置我们的预算模型。

blocks.en: The checks were made on the two eight-expert models at the compute of DiT-XL/2. Given the same inputs and weights, our implementation and the released code agree bitwise in BF16 on the forward output of the training branch and on the gradients of all parameters; both expert widths were checked (the check at expert width 1232 used a shared expert of width 608; the shared expert is an ordinary dense feed-forward network and does not go through the expert kernel). The remaining checks were done on the model with experts of width 768: a full-model FP32 forward pass on CPU with the 100k-step EMA weights gives a relative L 2 L_{2} error of 2.4 × 10 − 5 2.4\times 10^{-5} to 3.5 × 10 − 4 3.5\times 10^{-4} , and the gradient injected by the auxiliary loss agrees bitwise with explicit differentiation (CPU, FP32). A control trained with the original implementation of the released code (without kernel fusion) reaches FID 36.14 at 100k steps, comparable to the 37.20 of our implementation. The ordering of the training loss across evaluation points agrees with that of FID. FID evaluated with the raw (non-EMA) weights at 100k steps is 41.36, worse than the 37.20 with EMA weights, so the gap to DiT does not come from a mismatch between EMA weights and routing. The routing of the two models stays close to uniform over training: the normalized entropy, averaged over layers and positions, is between 0.96 and 0.98 at every checkpoint, and no expert is ever unused; the share of selections that goes to one expert (12.5% when uniform) ranges from 7% to 18% in the model with experts of width 1232 and from 1.3% to 29.4% at 400k steps in the model with experts of width 768.
blocks.zh: 这些检查是在DiT-XL/2的计算中对两个八专家模型进行的。 鉴于同样的投入和权重,我们的执行和发布的代码在BF16中就培训处的前进输出和所有参数的梯度都比特地达成一致;两个专家宽度都经过检查(专家宽度1232的检查使用了宽度608的共享专家;共享专家是普通密集的向导网络,不通过专家内核). 其余的检查是用宽度768的专家在模型上进行的:用100千步EMA权重的全型FP32前传CPU给出了相对的L 2 L_{2}2.4×10 − 5 2.4\times 10^{5}到3.5×10 − 4 3.5\times 10^{4},辅助损失所注入的梯度与明确区分一致(CPU, FP32)。 通过最初执行释放代码(没有内核核聚变)而训练出来的控制器在100千步达到FID 36.14,与我们执行的37.20相当. 各评价点的培训损失订单与FID一致。 与100k级的原始(非EMA)重量评价的FID为41.36,比有EMA重量的37.20级更差,因此与DiT的差不来自EMA重量和路由不匹配. 两个型号的路线在训练上接近一致:在每座检查站,均在0.96至0.98之间,各层和位置均匀,没有专家未被利用;在型号中,选择一名专家(统一时为12.5%)的比例从7%到18%不等,专家宽度为1232,在型号中,专家宽度为400公里,从1.3%到29.4%不等。

blocks.en: Two independent works that retrain this kind of routing next to a dense DiT under one protocol find the same direction as Secs. 5.2 and 5.3 . ProMoE (Table 10 of [ 74 ] ; DDPM, L tier, 500k steps) reports FID 23.12 without guidance and 7.55 at guidance scale 1.5 for its DiT-MoE-L, which has 8 experts with 1 selected and no shared expert, against 20.81 and 6.29 for the dense DiT-L (its Table 4). DiffMoE (Table 11 of [ 62 ] ; DDPM, L tier, 700k steps) reports 20.81 for token-choice routing with 16 experts against 17.87 for the dense DiT-L. In both, token-choice sparse experts are worse than the dense model at equal active parameters.
blocks.zh: 两个独立作品,在一个协议下的密集的DiT旁边重新训练这种路线,发现方向与Secs. 5.2和5.3相同. ProMOE([74]中的表10;DDPM,L级,500k步骤)报告FID 23.12,没有指导,DiT-MoE-L的指导级别为7.55,DiT-MoE-L有8名专家,1名选定,没有共享专家,而密度DiT-L为20.81,6.29(表4)。 DiffMoE([62]表11;DDPM,L级,700k步)报告有16位专家的20.81位符号选择路线,而密集的DiT-L为17.87位。 在这两种情况下,象征性选择的稀少专家都比在等效参数下密集的模型更差.

blocks.en: DiT-MoE is the baseline of the main text because the later models start from its design: ProMoE [ 74 ] , DiffMoE and EC-DiT keep a DiT backbone with a single pass over distinct layers and change how tokens are routed to the experts, a different axis from the budgeting of depth, parameters and compute studied here. We also compare with ProMoE at equal total parameters and compute. Its model code is ported from the authors’ release and checked against it: with the same inputs and weights, the forward pass and all gradients are bit-identical. The sampling and evaluation pipeline is checked with their released ProMoE-L/2 checkpoint (500k steps, rectified flow): sampled with 250 Euler steps, guidance 1.5, the ft-MSE VAE and 50k images, it gives FID 2.82, sFID 4.62 and IS 241.6 against 2.79, 4.58 and 244.2 reported by the authors, and our evaluator run on their released 50k samples gives 2.7925, identical to their log. We train the expert-choice variant, which the authors recommend for DDPM training, in the L configuration of their paper: the DiT-L/2 backbone (24 layers, width 1024) with a sparse feed-forward on every other layer, each with 12 routed experts selected by prototype routing, one shared and one unconditional expert, expert width 2048; 1.063B parameters in total, 0.458B active, 80.6 GMAC without the one-hot products that index tokens in its routing (82.2 with them). Two DyLoMo-DiT models are configured for this budget; they differ only in the number of routing heads. Both have 16 layers with the middle six looped, 24 experts per head with 2 selected, expert width 784 and shared width 880, and passes allocated by noise level as in Tab. 2 ; one has a single routing head, the recipe of Tab. 3 , and the other four heads of width 256, the head layout of the models of Tab. 2 (1.066B parameters, + 0.3 % +0.3\% , and 80.6 GMAC, − 0.02 % -0.02\% , for both; the heads split the hidden width, so the number of heads changes neither). All three are trained under our protocol (DDPM, batch 256, the ft-EMA VAE, no gradient clipping), which differs from theirs in the objective, the VAE and the clipping, so the numbers are not comparable to the rectified-flow numbers of their paper. The first seed of ProMoE-L reaches 30.07, 12.49, 7.89, 5.94 and 4.86 after 100k, 200k, 300k, 400k and 500k steps (400k as in our other comparisons, 500k as in the DDPM results of their paper). At 400k steps it is below the original configuration of DiT-MoE-L (7.50, Table J1 ) with 38% of its parameters and 36% of its compute. Its gain over the dense model is in line with their paper: at 400k steps under our protocol, this seed is 19.8% below DiT-L/2 (5.94 against 7.42) and the mean of three seeds 15% below it (6.28), and their DDPM comparison at 500k steps reports 18.6% (5.12 against 6.29, their Table 4). With the released checkpoint, this indicates that the port is faithful and that our protocol does not put ProMoE at a disadvantage. At the same five steps, the first seed of the four-head DyLoMo-DiT reaches 30.77, 12.03, 7.11, 5.15 and 4.05 and that of the single-head one 26.53, 11.84, 7.51, 5.60 and 4.56: they are 13% and 6% below ProMoE-L at 400k steps and 17% and 6% at 500k steps. At 400k steps the three models are repeated with further seeds ( Table H4 ): ProMoE-L reaches 5.94, 6.98 and 5.91 (mean 6.28), the four-head DyLoMo-DiT 5.15, 4.88 and 5.29 (mean 5.11) and the single-head one 5.60 and 5.79 (mean 5.70). In the seed means, the four-head model is 19% and the single-head model 9% below ProMoE-L, and four heads are 10% below one head; the seeds of ProMoE-L span 1.06 and those of the four-head model 0.42. We also trained ProMoE-XL, the XL configuration of their paper in the same variant ( 2.32 × 2.32\times the parameters of DiT-XL/2; its compute within 0.2% of DiT-XL/2 without the one-hot products and 1.6% above it with them), for 400k steps under our protocol. It reaches 4.78 with one seed, 14% below DiT-XL/2 (5.57). The DyLoMo-DiT-XL of Table 2 , with 44% of the parameters of ProMoE-XL at the same compute, reaches 4.22, 12% below it.
blocks.zh: DiT-MoE是正文的基线,因为后期的模型从设计开始:ProMoE [74],DiffMoE和EC-DIT保持一个DiT主干线,单通过一个不同的层,并改变符号的路由给专家,这是与这里研究的深度,参数和计算的预算不同的轴. 我们还在等总参数和计算上与ProMOE进行比较. 它的模型代码从作者的释放中移植出来,并对照它检查:使用相同的输入和权重,前传和所有梯度都是比特式的. 取样和评估管道用他们公布的ProMOE-L/2检查点(500k步骤,纠正流量):抽样的有250 Euler步骤、指导1.5、ft-MSE VAE和50k图像,给FID 2.82、SRID 4.62和IS 241.6对作者报告的2.79、4.58和244.2,我们的评价员在公布的50k样品上提供了2.7925,与他们的记录完全相同。 我们在论文的L配置中培训了专家选择的变体,作者推荐用于DDPM培训:DiT-L/2主干(24层,宽度1024),每层都有稀疏的饲料,每层有12位由原型路由选择的路由专家,1位共享和1位无条件的专家,专家宽度2048;总共1.063B参数,0.458B活跃,80.6GMAC没有在路由中索引符的单热产品(82.2与它们). 为这个预算配置了两个DyLoMo-DIT模型;它们仅在路由头的数量上有所不同. 这两层都有16层,中间6个环绕,每头24名专家,2个选定,专家宽度784,共享宽度880,通过与Tab一样按噪音级别分配。 2;一个有单一的路由头,Tab 3的配方,其他四个宽度256的车头,Tab 2的车头布局(1.066B参数,+0.3%+0.3++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 三者都根据我们的协议(DDPM,第256批,ft-EMA VAE,无梯度剪接)进行训练,这在目标,VAE和剪接上与他们的不同,因此数字与他们的纸张的校正流号不相称. blocks.en: At guidance scale 1.5, DyLoMo-DiT is 11% below DiT in the L tier and 15% below it in the XL tier; without guidance it is 14% and 17% below ( Table K1 ). Under the DDPM objective the gaps are 14% and 24% with guidance and 20% and 25% without ( Table 2 , App. H ). The L-tier entries are means over two seeds. At guidance scale 1.5, the two DiT-L/2 runs reach 6.75 and 6.57 and the two DyLoMo-DiT-L runs 5.90 and 6.00: both DyLoMo-DiT-L runs are below both DiT-L/2 runs, and the two seeds of a model differ by at most 0.19, against 0.71 between the means of the two models. The XL tier has one seed. The gain therefore carries over to a flow-matching objective; with this few seeds, its direction is better established than its size. The two objectives are sampled differently, so FID values are compared only within an objective.
